entities.name: Greater Videnth
entities.description: An island on Dominaria north of Umber and northeast of Terisiare, more than 1200 berim north of New Argive.

entities.name: Little Videnth Island
entities.description: A desolate, rocky atoll just east of the main island.

entities.name: Videnth
entities.description: A long-dead human civilization that colonized the southern part of the arctic supercontinent, which they named Upper Videnth.

entities.name: Upper Videnth
entities.description: Arctic supercontinent colonized by the Videnth.

entities.name: Videnthian Theory
entities.description: An erroneous hypothesis by some Argivian scholars that the Brothers' War took place around Videnth.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war whose scale the theory disputes.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: Ancient land that the theory claims was Little Videnth Island.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Land northeast of which Greater Videnth lies.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: Island 1200 berim south of Greater Videnth.

events.summary: The Videnth civilization colonizes the southern part of the arctic supercontinent and later dies out, probably from the Ice Age.
events.quote: That civilization is now long gone as well, probably due to harsh conditions during the Ice Age .

events.summary: Some Argivian scholars posit that Argoth was Little Videnth and most of Terisiare lies on Greater Videnth; opponents note the lack of resemblance.
events.quote: They believe that it is far more likely that ancient Argoth is, in fact, Little Videnth Island

relations.quote: The surrounding Sea is called the Videnthian Sea .

relations.note: Lies just east of the main island.
relations.quote: Just east of the main island lies Little Videnth Island .
